## Activity

During January 2020, East City Eye Clinic recorded 145 captures. This provides the activity total for the month and establishes the volume reviewed through the clinic’s image-capture process. The reported total is presented as captures rather than as a count of individual patients or appointments.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for grading. Of the 145 captures, 2 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.4. This result identifies the proportion of captured images that could not proceed to grading and should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for January 2020.

## Grading

The grading outcome included 25 referable results. The median lag for grading was 2. Together, these measures summarise the clinical findings requiring attention and the time taken for images to move through grading. The figures provide the monthly position for East City Eye Clinic and support routine monitoring of image quality, grading activity, and grading timeliness.
